topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 20 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 2 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 3 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc165, ownable2step, proxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
